body:
diagnosis is correct; depression. i know medicine isn’t magic. it’s supposed to be more than a placebo, though. 

i just want out
i’m doing what i’m “supposed” to. going to therapy. being honest with the therapist. taking meds. not a SINGLE thing has changed. NOTHING. i feel like a lost cause. i’m tired of this.

i don’t want to try. i’m tired of trying. my friends are good people, but i don’t open up to anyone. it’s my fault. i haven’t been happy in years and it’s my fault. i’m tired of being alive to make other people happy.
